thread:
anya - PM: Quick sync — ACME + two accounts pushed hard for "fast-routing" parity (per-tenant latency & route pinning). They want it next quarter. We need a decision: full parity vs pragmatic shim.

oscar - Sales: ACME will churn if we don't offer per-tenant routing controls. They said they'd sign a Dedicated commit if we can promise routing + per-route SLA. Not a bluff.

nate - Eng: Full parity implies: routing UI, tenant-scoped route table, scheduler changes, cross-region affinity. Rough order: ~8 sprints (infra + console + e2e tests). Big risk window.

li - ML: From model side parity means variant mapping + deterministic fallback rules. Also affects caching/kv semantics and might change token latencies. We need regression tests.

anya - PM: Proposal: do a two-step plan. 1) Shim MVP (policy layer that maps tenant -> route hints + guaranteed Dedicated routing for pinned tenants). 2) Roadmap full parity in parallel (longer project). Want to validate business and reduce churn asap.

nate - Eng: Agree shim-first. Suggest MVP scope (can be in a tiny checklist):
```
- route_hint header support (api)
- policy service that pins tenant -> pool (Dedicated only)
- console toggle to pin tenant (beta)
- telemetry: per-tenant latency, vortex routing traces
- canary rollout & auto-fallback to hosted model
```
Estimate: 3 sprints to get usable shim + basic console.

li - ML: For the shim we need to define quality guardrails. I'll run a prompt-set eval for pinned routing and baseline cache hit delta. Acceptable thresholds:
- accuracy delta < 2% on eval set
- avg token latency increase < 20ms

oscar - Sales: That's enough to start conversations. If we get a Dedicated PO, we can fast-track.

anya - PM: Launch criteria for shim:
- Pin API + policy live
- Canary running in prod for 2 weeks with <1% routing errors
- Telemetry dashboards surfaced to CS & Sales
- Sales commit or clear close plan for at least one account

deploy-bot: Canary created: routing-shim/v1 -> canary-2026-04-05

anya - PM: Action items:
- @nate scope sprint work + break into tickets (this week)
- @li run eval and define test suite (run 2x/day)
- @oscar draft customer comms & trial terms
- I'll own rollout plan and KPIs.

nate - Eng: I'll post tickets in #eng-runtime by EOD. :thumbsup:

li - ML: Starting eval now, will post results in thread baseline.csv link later.

oscar - Sales: I'll ping ACME and secure a term-sheet draft.

anya - PM: OK. We'll reconvene next Wed to approve go/no-go for shim canary.
